item.title: Japan’s Nikkei 225 share index falls more than 6% as oil soars over $100 a barrel
item.description: BANGKOK (AP) — Japan’s benchmark Nikkei 225 index plunged more than 6% early Monday after oil prices soared to over $100 a barrel due to disruptions from the war in the Middle East. item.title: NDSU Wins the Summit League for the 1st time since 2020
item.description: SIOUX FALLS (KVRR) – For the first time since 2020, the North Dakota State Bison have won the men’s basketball Summit League tournament. They won 70-62 over the North Dakota Fighting Hawks in the championship game. The Bison now wait for Selection Sunday next weekend to see who they will face in the first round.
